=== blink an LED with a busy loop
        .equ    DDRB, 0x17
        .equ    PORTB, 0x18
        .equ    LED, 5
        .text
        .globl  main
main:   sbi     DDRB, LED
loop:   sbi     PORTB, LED
        rcall   delay
        cbi     PORTB, LED
        rcall   delay
        rjmp    loop
delay:  ldi     r24, lo8(50000)
        ldi     r25, hi8(50000)
1:      sbiw    r24, 1
        brne    1b
        ret
=== echo characters on the UART
SPH = 0x3e
SPL = 0x3d
UDR = 0x0c
USR = 0x0b
UCR = 0x0a
RXC = 7
UDRE = 5
        .text
reset:  ldi     r16, lo8(0x025f)
        out     SPL, r16
        ldi     r16, hi8(0x025f)
        out     SPH, r16
        ldi     r16, (1 << 4) | (1 << 3)
        out     UCR, r16
echo:   sbis    USR, RXC
        rjmp    echo
        in      r24, UDR
        rcall   putc
        rjmp    echo
putc:   sbis    USR, UDRE
        rjmp    putc
        out     UDR, r24
        ret
=== strings in program memory, read through Z
        .text
        .globl  puts
puts:   ldi     r30, lo8(msg)
        ldi     r31, hi8(msg)
2:      lpm
        tst     r0
        breq    3f
        mov     r24, r0
        adiw    r30, 1
        rcall   putc
        rjmp    2b
3:      ret
putc:   ret
msg:    .asciz  "Hello"
        .balign 2
=== 16-bit and 24-bit arithmetic
        .text
add16:  add     r24, r22
        adc     r25, r23
        ret
sub16:  sub     r24, r22
        sbc     r25, r23
        ret
neg16:  com     r25
        neg     r24
        sbci    r25, -1
        ret
add24:  add     r22, r18
        adc     r23, r19
        adc     r24, r20
        ret
shl16:  lsl     r24
        rol     r25
        ret
shr16:  lsr     r25
        ror     r24
        ret
cmp16:  cp      r24, r22
        cpc     r25, r23
        brlo    1f
        clr     r24
1:      ret
=== copying .data and clearing .bss, as avr-libc's startup does for a small core
        .text
        .globl  __do_copy_data
__do_copy_data:
        ldi     r17, hi8(__data_end)
        ldi     r26, lo8(__data_start)
        ldi     r27, hi8(__data_start)
        ldi     r30, lo8(__data_load_start)
        ldi     r31, hi8(__data_load_start)
        rjmp    .L__do_copy_data_start
.L__do_copy_data_loop:
        lpm
        adiw    r30, 1
        st      X+, r0
.L__do_copy_data_start:
        cpi     r26, lo8(__data_end)
        cpc     r27, r17
        brne    .L__do_copy_data_loop
        .globl  __do_clear_bss
__do_clear_bss:
        ldi     r18, hi8(__bss_end)
        ldi     r26, lo8(__bss_start)
        ldi     r27, hi8(__bss_start)
        rjmp    .do_clear_bss_start
.do_clear_bss_loop:
        st      X+, r1
.do_clear_bss_start:
        cpi     r26, lo8(__bss_end)
        cpc     r27, r18
        brne    .do_clear_bss_loop
        ret
=== a jump table through program-memory addresses
        .text
dispatch:
        ldi     r30, pm_lo8(table)
        ldi     r31, pm_hi8(table)
        add     r30, r24
        adc     r31, r1
        ijmp
table:  rjmp    case0
        rjmp    case1
        rjmp    case2
case0:  ldi     r24, 0
        ret
case1:  ldi     r24, 1
        ret
case2:  ldi     r24, 2
        ret
fptrs:  .word   gs(case0), gs(case1), pm(case2)
=== a frame through Y with displacements
        .text
f:      push    r28
        push    r29
        in      r28, 0x3d
        in      r29, 0x3e
        sbiw    r28, 8
        in      r0, 0x3f
        cli
        out     0x3e, r29
        out     0x3f, r0
        out     0x3d, r28
        std     Y+1, r24
        std     Y+2, r25
        ldd     r18, Y+1
        ldd     r19, Y+2
        std     Y+8, r18
        ldd     r24, Y+8
        adiw    r28, 8
        in      r0, 0x3f
        cli
        out     0x3e, r29
        out     0x3f, r0
        out     0x3d, r28
        pop     r29
        pop     r28
        ret
=== a macro and repetition
        .macro  outw port, value
        ldi     r16, hi8(\value)
        out     \port + 1, r16
        ldi     r16, lo8(\value)
        out     \port, r16
        .endm
        .text
        outw    0x2c, 0x1234
        outw    0x2a, 0xbeef
        .rept   3
        nop
        .endr
        .irp    reg, r16, r17, r18
        push    \reg
        .endr
        .irp    reg, r18, r17, r16
        pop     \reg
        .endr
        ret
=== statements separated by a dollar, and comments
        .text
        ldi r16, 1 $ ldi r17, 2 ; two loads
# a whole-line comment
        mov r18, r16 $ add r18, r17
        ret $ nop ; nop after ret
=== bit twiddling on SREG and register bits
        .text
        bset    7
        bclr    7
        sei
        cli
        bst     r24, 3
        bld     r25, 3
        sbrc    r24, 0
        sbrs    r24, 7
        brts    1f
        brtc    1f
        brhs    1f
        brhc    1f
        brie    1f
        brid    1f
        brvs    1f
        brvc    1f
        brmi    1f
        brpl    1f
        brge    1f
        brlt    1f
1:      ret
=== pointer loads through every register and mode
        .text
        ld      r0, X
        ld      r1, X+
        ld      r2, -X
        ld      r3, Y
        ld      r4, Y+
        ld      r5, -Y
        ld      r6, Z
        ld      r7, Z+
        ld      r8, -Z
        st      X, r9
        st      X+, r10
        st      -X, r11
        st      Y, r12
        st      Y+, r13
        st      -Y, r14
        st      Z, r15
        st      Z+, r16
        st      -Z, r17
        ldd     r18, Y+63
        std     Z+62, r19
        lds     r20, 0x1234
        sts     0xfedc, r21
        push    r22
        pop     r23
        ret
=== the location counter and differences in code
        .text
start:  ldi     r16, end - start
        ldi     r17, lo8(end - start)
        .word   end - start
        .byte   . - start
        .balign 2
end:    ret
=== clang -O2 for the at90s8515
__tmp_reg__ = 0
__zero_reg__ = 1
__SREG__ = 63
__SP_H__ = 62
__SP_L__ = 61
	.file	"prog1.c"
	.text
	.globl	__vector_16                     ; -- Begin function __vector_16
	.p2align	1
	.type	__vector_16,@function
__vector_16:                            ; @__vector_16
; %bb.0:
	push	r0
	in	r0, 63
	push	r0
	push	r24
	push	r25
	lds	r24, ticks
	lds	r25, ticks+1
	adiw	r24, 1
	sts	ticks+1, r25
	sts	ticks, r24
	pop	r25
	pop	r24
	pop	r0

	pop	r0
	reti
.Lfunc_end0:
	.size	__vector_16, .Lfunc_end0-__vector_16

	.globl	puts_                           ; -- Begin function puts_

	.type	puts_,@function
puts_:                                  ; @puts_
; %bb.0:
	mov	r30, r24
	mov	r31, r25
	ld	r24, Z
	cpi	r24, 0
	breq	.LBB1_3
.LBB1_1:                                ; =>This Inner Loop Header: Depth=1
	lds	r25, 192
	andi	r25, 32
	cpi	r25, 0
	breq	.LBB1_1
; %bb.2:                                ;   in Loop: Header=BB1_1 Depth=1
	sts	198, r24
	mov	r26, r30
	mov	r27, r31
	adiw	r26, 1
	ldd	r24, Z+1
	cpi	r24, 0
	mov	r30, r26
	mov	r31, r27
	brne	.LBB1_1
.LBB1_3:
	ret
.Lfunc_end1:

	ret

                                        ; -- End function
	.globl	run                             ; -- Begin function run

run:                                    ; @run
; %bb.0:
	ldi	r18, pm_lo8(nothing)
	ldi	r19, pm_hi8(nothing)
	sts	handlers+7, r19
	sts	handlers+6, r18
	ldi	r20, pm_lo8(blink)
	ldi	r21, pm_hi8(blink)
	sts	handlers+5, r21
	sts	handlers+4, r20
	sts	handlers+3, r19
	sts	handlers+2, r18
	sts	handlers+1, r21
	sts	handlers, r20
	andi	r24, 3
	mov	r30, r24
	clr	r31
	lsl	r30
	rol	r31
	subi	r30, lo8(-(handlers))
	sbci	r31, hi8(-(handlers))
	ld	r24, Z
	ldd	r25, Z+1
	mov	r30, r24
	mov	r31, r25
	icall
	ret

                                        ; -- End function

blink:                                  ; @blink
; %bb.0:

	eor	r25, r24
	out	5, r25
	ret
.Lfunc_end6:

; %bb.0:

	; Declaring this symbol tells the CRT that it should
	;copy all variables from program memory to RAM on startup

	.size	div16, .Lfunc_end3-div16
                                        ; -- End function
	.globl	classify                        ; -- Begin function classify
	.p2align	1
	.type	classify,@function
classify:                               ; @classify
; %bb.0:
	cpi	r24, 7
	cpc	r25, r1
	brlo	.LBB4_2
; %bb.1:
	ldi	r24, 255
	ldi	r25, 255
	ret
.LBB4_2:
	adiw	r24, 10
	ret
.Lfunc_end4:
	.size	classify, .Lfunc_end4-classify
                                        ; -- End function
	.globl	run                             ; -- Begin function run
	.p2align	1
	.type	run,@function
run:                                    ; @run
; %bb.0:
	ldi	r18, pm_lo8(nothing)
	ldi	r19, pm_hi8(nothing)
	sts	handlers+7, r19
	sts	handlers+6, r18
	ldi	r20, pm_lo8(blink)
	ldi	r21, pm_hi8(blink)

	sts	handlers+4, r20
	sts	handlers+3, r19
	sts	handlers+2, r18
	sts	handlers+1, r21
	sts	handlers, r20
	andi	r24, 3
	mov	r30, r24
	clr	r31
	lsl	r30
	rol	r31
	subi	r30, lo8(-(handlers))
	sbci	r31, hi8(-(handlers))
	ld	r24, Z
	ldd	r25, Z+1
	mov	r30, r24
	mov	r31, r25
	icall
	ret
.Lfunc_end5:
	.size	run, .Lfunc_end5-run
                                        ; -- End function
	.p2align	1                               ; -- Begin function blink
	.type	blink,@function
blink:                                  ; @blink
; %bb.0:

	in	r25, 5
	eor	r25, r24
	out	5, r25
	ret
.Lfunc_end6:
	.size	blink, .Lfunc_end6-blink
                                        ; -- End function
	.p2align	1                               ; -- Begin function nothing
	.type	nothing,@function
nothing:                                ; @nothing
; %bb.0:
	ret
.Lfunc_end7:
	.size	nothing, .Lfunc_end7-nothing

	.globl	main                            ; -- Begin function main

; %bb.0:

	push	r3
	push	r4
	push	r5

	push	r9

	andi	r19, 32
	cpi	r19, 0
	breq	.LBB8_1

	mov	r30, r24

	sts	handlers+6, r24

	mov	r21, r17

	; Declaring this symbol tells the CRT that it should
	;copy all variables from program memory to RAM on startup
	.globl	__do_copy_data
	; Declaring this symbol tells the CRT that it should
	;clear the zeroed data section on startup
	.globl	__do_clear_bss
	.type	counter,@object                 ; @counter
	.data

counter:
	.long	305419896                       ; 0x12345678
	.size	counter, 4

	.type	handlers,@object                ; @handlers
	.section	.bss,"aw",@nobits
	.globl	handlers
handlers:
	.zero	8
	.size	handlers, 8
